notes.title: Demo 2.0 release!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, Cyra here! Big news! The [b]Cyra and the Beacon Path[/b] demo received a huge update!
﻿
The city got a major visual upgrade – totally overhauled art and VFX. The whole area feels much more vibrant. And that's not all! We've added 7 brand new levels to test your skills.
﻿
To sweeten the deal, these new levels come with a couple brand new, super-challenging collectables. Think you can grab them all? It won't be easy...
﻿
So, what are you waiting for? Download the updated demo today!
﻿
See you there!
[i]Cyra Kallis[/i]

notes.title: Demo v0.1.5 Release!
notes.notes:
We're super excited to announce that our first demo is available to be played!

In the demo you'll get to play as Cyra through the tutorial area of the game. [b]Right now it's only setup to support English keyboards so you will have to change your keyboard configuration to English to make sure button prompts display correctly.[/b]

Be sure to join our Discord if you're interested in keeping up to date with development, giving feedback, or would like to ask us any questions! We're always happen to answer anything.

Thank you so much for trying our game,
Up Down Interactive
